title: Erasca, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Erasca, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a conference call on April 27, 2026 to discuss preliminary Phase 1 dose escalation data for its pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015. The filing also discloses that Revolution Medicines sent a cease-and-desist letter on April 24, 2026 alleging patent infringement and trade secret misappropriation related to ERAS-0015.
key_points: Erasca will host a conference call on April 27, 2026 at 4:30 pm ET to present Phase 1 dose escalation data for ERAS-0015 in RAS-mutant solid tumors
Revolution Medicines sent a letter on April 24, 2026 alleging ERAS-0015 infringes U.S. Patent No. 12,409,225 under doctrine of equivalents
RevMed also alleges trade secret misappropriation and improper comparative statements versus RMC-6236
Erasca states the assertions are without merit and intends to contest the allegations vigorously
ERAS trades on Nasdaq Global Select Market under symbol ERAS
why_it_matters: This 8-K is relevant only to ERAS equity investors and is not related to market structure or macro catalysts. The patent dispute with Revolution Medicines could materially impact Erasca's ERAS-0015 program if the claims are successful.
